description: My go-to Christmas cookie recipe — a little less sugar but still super buttery, soft, and actually so good!!🥹 Ingredients (makes 12–15 cookies): - 100 g softened butter - 70 g sugar (e.g., half regular sugar, half erythritol) - 1 egg (medium) - 1 tsp vanilla extract - 200 g all-purpose flour - ½ tsp baking powder - Pinch of salt Optional: - Vanilla sugar or lemon zest - Christmas sprinkles or chopped chocolate Instructions: 1. Whisk butter and sugar until creamy, then mix in egg and vanilla. 2. Fold in flour, baking powder, and salt until just combined. 3. Chill the dough for 20–30 minutes. 4. Roll out dough, cut into shapes, and bake at 180°C / 350°F for 10–12 minutes until lightly golden. 💡 Tip: Bake slightly less for extra soft cookies. Who’s baking these with me? 🤭 #healthierbaking #christmascookies #balancednotrestricted #holidaybaking #fitnessfriendly
